+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

+     DRAFT PLACEHOLDER — INCOMPLETE — NOT A REAL PROCESS DEFINITION

+  <bpmn:process id="Process_PLACEHOLDER"
+                name="{{PROCESS_NAME}}"
+                isExecutable="false">
